outcome: Give game studio cto / live operations director a governed method to improve time to review severe harm reports using reported chat, moderation rules and player appeals, with final decisions…
overview: Toxic Chat Harm Escalation addresses operational records arrive through different systems, supervisors reconstruct evidence manually, and decisions are difficult to audit in gaming and esports operations. The first proof of value uses reported chat, moderation rules and player appeals. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is time to review severe harm reports, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.
kpi: time to review severe harm reports

benefits.limits: Basis: customer-specific hypothesis. No uplift promised; validate in controlled pilot

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: reported chat, moderation rules and player appeals; define time to review severe harm reports and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Game Studio CTO / Live Operations Director.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including line-by-line reconciliations against known business transactions.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
deliverables: Agreed test threshold for time to review severe harm reports
